title: AppSettingsUpdate
description:
The writable fields of app settings as a merge patch. Custom tools have their own
probe-validated endpoints, so a settings write preserves them instead of bypassing that
probe. An absent field keeps its stored value; a present field replaces it.

delete_chunks_on_success.description: Whether encoded chunks are deleted after a successful run.

desktop_notifications.description: Which run lifecycle events may produce a desktop notification.

enabled.description: Whether the desktop host may send any run notification.

failed.description: A run that stops on an error.

finished.description: A run that reaches its normal end.

started.description: The first sequence start for a run.

preview_overlay.description: The scene and run facts drawn over the preview.

chunk.description: The retained chunk's size, when one exists.

enabled.description: Whether the overlay is drawn at all.

encoder.description: The encoder label resolved for the scene.

fps_eta.description: Frames or scenes per second, and the remaining-time estimate.

noise.description: The scene's measured noise and scale.

progress.description: The active sequence's percentage and phase.

target_quality.description: The scene's Target Quality quantizer and probe score.

reduce_motion.description: Reduce motion even when the operating system does not ask for it.

temp_dir.description: Temporary-directory override; `null` uses the app-data default.
